result.reason: The revision appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors, limits subscription termination to the Section 13.3 breach process, and permits successor transfers. However, Section 13.3 applies to “a licence” generally and permits revocation for certain uncured breaches, potentially overriding the absolute irrevocability promised for paid-up licences in Section 13.2. It should expressly apply only to subscription licences, and ideally refer consistently to termination, revocation, and suspension. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the commercial distinction between subscription and paid-up rights.
